translations.guide.title: User guide
translations.guide.subtitle: Only areas you can access are shown. Open a section for input rules, statuses and business workflows.

translations.guide.physical.title: Individuals and relationship tree
translations.guide.physical.summary: A unified record for employees, related persons and family members.
translations.guide.physical.point1: A new record uses two steps: identity, then relationship and validity period. Actions depend on your application permissions.
translations.guide.physical.point2: A valid national ID is required for residents and a passport number for non-residents. National ID, passport and FBA ID cannot be duplicated across active records.
translations.guide.physical.point3: Selecting an immediate family member pre-fills and locks business yes/no choices. Selecting another basis resets and unlocks them.
translations.guide.physical.point4: Verifying a draft refreshes its status and removes the verification action after success.
translations.guide.physical.point5: The relationship tree displays recorded family and other links for an individual, including an employee.
translations.guide.physical.point6: Excel import validates structure, columns and rows on the backend; export downloads recorded data. Deletion deactivates the record and removes it from active views.
translations.guide.legal.title: Legal entities
translations.guide.legal.summary: Recording, verification and data exchange for related legal entities.
translations.guide.legal.point1: Name and relationship basis are required; identifiers and dates are checked against residency and business rules.
translations.guide.legal.point2: An authorised user can edit, verify or deactivate a record. The table refreshes after a successful action.
translations.guide.legal.point3: Excel import accepts the prescribed template with safe row/column feedback; export downloads the complete view.
translations.guide.limits.title: Limits
translations.guide.limits.summary: Financial limits linked to legal entities.
translations.guide.limits.point1: Limits store amount, utilisation, adjustment, deadline and comment. Numeric fields reject text and disallowed negative values.
translations.guide.limits.point2: Available limit is calculated by the backend from recorded values and is not entered manually.
translations.guide.limits.point3: Regulatory and core capital come from the business backend, without browser calculations. Capital has a separate screen and permissions.
translations.guide.limits.point4: Excel export uses module data. Limit deletion is permanent and requires confirmation; it is not deactivation.
translations.guide.capital.title: Capital
translations.guide.capital.point1: Capital is separate from limits. Read/export and mutation use separate permissions from the current application database, not direct Keycloak roles.
translations.guide.capital.point2: Missing capital is shown as not recorded, not invented zeroes. Saved data is reloaded from the server.
translations.guide.reports.title: Regulatory reporting
translations.guide.reports.point1: Authenticated users who are not disabled can view and download existing reports. Without an explicit application role their effective access is Guest.
translations.guide.reports.point2: Generating a daily or monthly report permanently creates a database record. It is not read-only: only Capital and Admin may generate through application permissions.
translations.guide.reports.point3: If download fails after generation, use the existing saved report. Do not regenerate only to download it.
translations.guide.notifications.title: Notifications
translations.guide.notifications.point1: The list shows recipient, subject, audience, status and recorded time according to the actual API contract. Blazor does not send email.
translations.guide.notifications.point2: An empty local log with SMTP does not prove that messages were not sent. Verify delivery in the corresponding environment and provider.
translations.guide.administration.title: Administration
translations.guide.administration.summary: Users, access, period, code lists and audit trail.
translations.guide.administration.point1: Keycloak provides identity. PL, FL, Capital, Limits and Admin are database-owned application accesses and may be combined. Signed-in users have baseline Guest read access.
translations.guide.administration.point2: Additional access is linked to an existing identity through application records. Removing additional roles returns the user to Guest access unless the final active Admin would be lost. You cannot deactivate/delete yourself or remove the final active Admin access.
translations.guide.administration.point3: Active code-list values populate business form choices; inactive values remain in history. The backend rejects deletion of referenced values or lists. Import uses preview and explicit valid-row confirmation.
translations.guide.administration.point4: A locked period blocks physical-person, legal-entity, limit and capital mutations and verification according to middleware rules. Admin UI retains lock, request, rejection, clarification and approval/unlock. Reason/note: 10–500 characters; user clarification: 10–490, without truncation.
translations.guide.administration.point5: Audit is a read-only view of changes, actor, time, area, IP and available before/after values. Only administrators can access it.
translations.guide.before: Check required fields, identifiers, dates and business basis. The backend remains authoritative. If saving has an unknown outcome, refresh before resubmitting; a connection failure does not prove the record was not saved.
